technology_patterns.title: Continuously Adopt New Technologies
technology_patterns.statement: I enjoy learning and adopting new technologies and skills. I do not want to restrict my growth to technologies I already know.

technology_patterns.title: Interest in Automation
technology_patterns.statement: I enjoy working with automation and finding smarter and more efficient ways to perform work.
technology_patterns.mindset: Build smarter processes instead of relying only on repetitive manual work.

technology_patterns.title: Technology All-Rounder
technology_patterns.statement: I continuously build capabilities across multiple technical and creative areas. I see this multidisciplinary learning as part of becoming an all-rounder.
technology_patterns.mindset: I want to understand and work across complementary domains instead of limiting myself to one narrow skill.

technology_patterns.title: Technology Through Practical Experience
technology_patterns.statement: When I learn a new technology, I prefer gaining practical experience with it so that I can understand how it works beyond theory.
